text_block_list.text:
It's the first day of our training in
preparation for
the Champions Cup.

The scheduled start time comes and
goes, but
Smart Falcon is nowhere to be
seen.

I don't think she's simply playing hooky.
In fact, I
have an idea of where she
might be...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Gyah! Trainer?! What are you doing h—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahem! ☆ I mean, you found me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry I skipped training! But... I
just didn't
know what to do.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I'm not sure. It's my problem,
after all.
choice_data_list: Can I be of any help?
Can I be of any help?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But... I guess it might be all right to
share my
worries with you...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So, um... Do you remember when that
girl told me
I was sparkly a while back?

text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails
text_block_list.text:
I love all your songs! And how you
sparkle when
you dance!

text_block_list.name: Girl with Pigtails
text_block_list.text:
I want to sparkle just like you when I
grow up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, the thing is... lately, I don't feel
like I've got
that sparkle.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm onstage, it's like I'm not
having any
fun at all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I bet you're surprised, right? After all,
my
concerts have been great.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
They've been perfect, even. I win... I
sing... I
dance... I win again...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've built up plenty of excitement and
dominated
the trending topics.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The concerts have been full of cheering
people and brilliant lights... And the
stage of my dreams
only feels a little
ways off.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But... it's like something's changed deep
down.
Like I'm not the same person who
had that dream.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even though my dream to become the
top
Umadol on dirt is just about to come
true. It's
funny, isn't it...

There's never been more hype
surrounding dirt racing. At the JBC
Classic, Oi Racecourse was
practically
bursting at the seams.

Thanks to Smart Falcon's hard work, her
dream of
becoming the top Umadol on
dirt is steadily
becoming reality.

But it looks like somewhere along the
way, her
heart may have fallen out of it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is this what they call "getting cold
feet"?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like, if you're too happy, you actually
get really
anxious. Haha... suffering from
success, right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: You don't have to force a smile.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Face what? I don't get it...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I should be on top of the world! The
dream that
seemed so far off is now
within my reach...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You know what it is. To become the top
Umadol
on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I've been winning all these
races. The
more I win, the higher I rise...
towards the to—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hold on... Is that what the top
means to me?
Just winning?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that can't be right... My dream is to
be a top
Umadol who... who...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: A favor?
choice_data_list: I have a favor to ask.
I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: I want you to perform a live show ...
I want you to perform a concert fo...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahem.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hiii! ♪ It's me, Smart Falcon! ☆ Taking
flight
gracefully from a cliff's edge!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha. This feels... awkward. Anyway, um...
hope
you enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hm-hmm. ♪ Here we... go?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Um, ehe. I was waiting for the chant...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Perfect! ☆ Next, let's do it to an eight
beat!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Beautiful! I'm gonna shift it up a gear
too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff... You too, Trainer. Thanks for going all out with the cheering! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, your smile was suuuper awesome!
Enough
to make me get serious! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That took me back to the day we first
met.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a single person in the
audience back
then. Even so, I would
sing and dance every day,
rain or shine.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I never once thought about giving up.
Because
whatever happened, I...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I... wanted to shine like a
star!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To shine just like the girls I'd seen on
stage...
brighter than even the spotlights
above me...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
And to yell "Here I am!" at the top of my
lungs!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...How could I be so stupid? I forgot
what's most
important to me.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I got so caught up in making dirt races
more popular, it was all I could think
about. I told myself it was all up to me,
when it was never my responsibility in
the first place.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...I've been the worst Umadol.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It is!
All I've been doing is just standing
onstage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I lost sight of the feelings I wanted to
share with
my fans...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: But your brilliance reached the fans.
But your brilliance reached the fans.

text_block_list.name: Falco Fan A
text_block_list.text: Gooo! Yeaaah, Falcooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Falcooo!
Way to gooo!

When Smart Falcon performs, it inspires
her fans
to wave their lights with all their
hearts. If she wasn't shining, the
audience would be a sea of black.

The fact that those lights have gotten
brighter
and brighter is proof that she's
shining.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All their lights...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: You've been shining this whole time.
You've been shining this whole time.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Only my fans could tell me if that's
really—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aha... That's right. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I'll try and believe in myself...
at least
a little.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey! You know to call me Falco! ☆
...Hehe.

Illuminated by the evening light,
something glistens momentarily in Smart
Falcon's eyes. I pretend not to notice
the sparkling droplet as it falls to the
ground.
